title: Homotopy-invertible bar augmentations give an invertible cone augmentation
statement: Let I be a preorder and A a preadditive category with a zero object, binary biproducts, and coproducts in the universes of I and Nat. Let φ:D→E be a natural transformation between I-diagrams of cochain complexes. Let c,e be cocones to an arrow f:c.pt→e.pt, with φ(i);e(i)=c(i);f. If the canonical total augmentations for D and E [def-sc-preorder-bar-total] become isomorphisms in the homotopy category, so does the canonical total augmentation from the objectwise cone-diagram bar to mappingCone(f) [def-sc-preorder-bar-cone-diagram].

source.place: The source-bar, least-block unit contraction, and finite-cone-block paragraphs.

proof.text: The two bar augmentations and their naturality square define a map of the mapping-cone triangles in the homotopy category. Both triangles are distinguished by Mathlib mappingCone_triangleh_distinguished. Apply isIso₃_of_isIso₁₂ to get invertibility of the induced cone map from the two hypotheses. The total-cone augmentation equality identifies the desired map with the composite of this map and the total-cone isomorphism. Its quotient map is therefore an isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem coneAugmentation_isIso (c : Cocone D) (e : Cocone E) (f : c.pt ⟶ e.pt)
    (hf : ∀ i, φ.app i ≫ e.ι.app i = c.ι.app i ≫ f)
    (hc : IsIso ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      (totalAugmentation D c)))
    (he : IsIso ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      (totalAugmentation E e))) :
    IsIso ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      (totalAugmentation (coneDiagram φ) (coneCocone φ c e f hf)))
